description:
If you are wondering what makes Trimedx different, it's that all of our associates share in a common purpose of serving clients, patients, communities, and each other with equal measures of care and performance. 
 Everyone is focused on serving the customer and we do that by collaborating and supporting each other
 Associates look forward to coming to work each day
 Every associate matters and makes a difference
 
 It is truly a culture like no other — We hope you will join our team! Find out more about our company and culture here .


 When the Most Complex Systems Fail, You’re Who They Call 
 You’ve put in the years—now take ownership of the hardest equipment in the hospital. Step into a role where your expertise drives uptime on MRI, CT, and beyond.

 What You’ll Do 
 Own the critical path—diagnose and restore high-end imaging systems with speed and precision.
 Lead the work—direct vendors, guide teams, and set the standard for technical excellence.
 Safeguard compliance—align with physicists and regulations to ensure every scan is safe and accurate.
 Multiply impact—mentor others and shape how imaging support is done across the site.
 You’re Our Person If… 
 You handle complex systems without guesswork—you get to root cause.
 You’re the one others call when MRI, CT, or Cath Lab issues get tough.
 You communicate clearly with clinicians and earn their trust quickly.
 You raise the bar for documentation, process, and technical rigor.
 
 Why Us 
You’ll work at the top of your craft, trusted to make critical calls that affect patient care. We back experienced engineers with real autonomy and the chance to mentor the next generation.

 TRIMEDX Offers: 
 Comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, 401K, Paid-Time Off
 Ongoing training and education
 Growth and promotional opportunities
 Job opportunities available on a national level
 International volunteer opportunities through the TRIMEDX Foundation
 Annual Merit Increases

 What You Need 
 Minimum 5 years’ experience in the repair, maintenance, troubleshooting, and installation of medical imaging equipment
 Associate’s degree in electronics/technical field or equivalent experience (required; waived with TRIMEDX certification or similar)
 Bachelor’s in engineering technology (preferred)
 Strong computer diagnostics, networking basics, and Excel
 Valid driver’s license and ability to travel
 Applicants can expect a compensation range of $40-$50 for this opportunity.  This is the reasonable estimate that TRIMEDX believes it might pay for this particular job based on applicable circumstances at the time of posting. TRIMEDX may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range as permitted by law, and commensurate with the applicant’s experience and qualifications.

 Ready to own the systems others won’t touch? Apply now. 
 At Trimedx, we are committed to cultivating a workplace culture where every associate feels valued, supported, and empowered to thrive. This culture reflects our belief that our people are our foundation, their well-being is essential, and shared success is built through meaningful work, recognition, and opportunities for growth.

 We embrace people’s differences which include age, race, color, ethnicity, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, education, genetics, veteran status, disability, religion, beliefs, opinions and life experiences.  

 Visit our website to view our Workplace Culture Commitment , along with our social channels to see what our team is up to: Facebook , LinkedIn , Twitter .
  
 Trimedx is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Drug-Free Workplace.
 Because we are committed to providing a safe and productive work environment, Trimedx is a drug-free workplace. Accordingly, Associates are prohibited from engaging in the unlawful manufacture, sale, distribution, dispensation, possession, or use of any controlled substance or marijuana, or otherwise being under the influence thereof, on all Trimedx and Customer property or during working/on-call hours. 

 Trimedx may also provide associates with benefits that include health/dental/vision, HSA/FSA, matching retirement plans, paid vacation and parental leave, adoption/infertility assistance, and more!
